preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in x) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in y)
preconditions.description: Both strings x and y consist only of lowercase Latin letters.
The lengths of x and y are between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: result == sum(f(l1, r1, l2, r2) for l1 in range(1, len(x)+1) for r1 in range(l1, len(x)+1) for l2 in range(1, len(y)+1) for r2 in range(l2, len(y)+1)) % 998244353
postconditions.description: The result is the sum over all non-empty substrings of x and y of the number of different merging sequences that produce chaotic merges, modulo 998244353.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= l1 <= r1 <= len(x) for l1 in range(1, len(x)+1) for r1 in range(l1, len(x)+1)) and all(1 <= l2 <= r2 <= len(y) for l2 in range(1, len(y)+1) for r2 in range(l2, len(y)+1))
postconditions.description: The substrings are valid non-empty substrings of x and y.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= f(l1, r1, l2, r2) for l1 in range(1, len(x)+1) for r1 in range(l1, len(x)+1) for l2 in range(1, len(y)+1) for r2 in range(l2, len(y)+1))
postconditions.description: f(l1, r1, l2, r2) is a non-negative integer for all valid substrings.
